# URLCode mail

> Plain-text transactional email: templates contributed by other extensions, one operator transport. Serves no
> routes. Released with core and installed with `urlcode extensions add mail`. Apache-2.0.

Part of the URLCode framework, in the same repository: docs/FRAMEWORK.md

## What a project declares (YAML only; never packages, code, addresses or credentials)
- `extensions.mail.config.defaultLocale`: the fallback locale (default `en`).
- `extensions.mail.config.copy`: locale -> `mail/copy/<name>.json`, overriding or translating contributed
  templates by `<namespace>.<key>`; every `{slot}` is kept.
- No routes: a route with `extension: mail` is refused.

## What the operator chooses (host.mjs)
- `mail({transport, from, recipients, maxConcurrent, deadlineMs})`. With no transport, messages go to
  `<site>/data/outbox` on a loopback origin only; elsewhere delivery is off until a transport is named.
- `sesTransport({region})` for production; `outboxTransport`, `consoleTransport` and `recordingTransport` are
  development transports, refused off the node target.

## What an extension does with it
- Contribute `contributes: {mail: {namespace, templates}}` and read `ctx.get('mail')` (types only:
  `import type { MailExports } from '@jimhoyd/urlcode-mail'`).
- `send({template, to, values, locale?, signal?})`; check `available`; ask for operator recipients by name.

## Read in this order
- [README](README.md): options, transports, slot kinds, copy files, error codes.
- [SECURITY](SECURITY.md): what mail keeps and what stays with the consumer.
- docs/EXTENSIONS.md#generic-add-on-authoring-rules: the rules every add-on satisfies.

## Do not guess
- No HTML, attachments, Reply-To, CC/BCC, SMTP, queueing or retries beyond SES's two attempts.
